concerns.text: FR‑001 (download METSIM muscle RNA‑seq TPM matrices and phenotype) is not satisfied – METSIM is unavailable and the plan substitutes GTEx, which does not meet the functional requirement of using METSIM data.
FR‑002 (binary MetS classification according to ATP‑III) is omitted; the plan treats binary labeling as exploratory and does not produce the required MetS/Control labels.

FR‑005 (multivariate logistic regression predicting MetS status) cannot be executed because a binary MetS label is not produced; the plan marks the modeling step as optional/exploratory, leaving the requirement unmet.
FR‑006 (k‑fold cross‑validation for the logistic model) is contingent on the existence of the logistic model; since FR‑005 is not fulfilled, the cross‑validation requirement is also unaddressed.
FR‑010 (external validation on MESA muscle RNA‑seq) is documented as unavailable; the specification explicitly requires this validation, so the functional requirement remains unmet.
FR‑026 (use a primary cohort that provides both RNA‑seq and full ATP‑III clinical variables) is violated – the plan substitutes GTEx, which lacks the required clinical data.

FR‑027 (correlation results must conform to correlation_results.schema.yaml) is not explicitly referenced in the phase‑to‑FR mapping; although schema validation is mentioned elsewhere, FR‑027 itself is missing from the mapping.
FR‑028 (validation‑step output must conform to validation_results.schema.yaml) is not listed in the phase‑to‑FR mapping, leaving the requirement unaddressed.
The plan references FR‑018 and FR‑017, which do not exist in the specification; these are over‑reaches and should be removed or replaced with actual FR IDs from the spec.
FR‑018 appears multiple times (Phase 1, Phase 2, Phase 11) but is not defined in the spec, constituting unnecessary plan elements.
FR‑017 is listed in Phase 7 but has no definition in the spec; this should be eliminated or mapped to a real requirement.
